'''Andews Rolo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal.

==Biography==
Andews Rolo was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who turned to crime at a young age, eventually coming to lead the [[Spectrader Ring]], a gang that operated on over thirty [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Despite this, Rolo was a mere nuisance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was eventually captured. However, he was left alive and exiled to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. This was due to the influence of a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] who believed the threat of his return would keep the new, more pliant, leaders of the Spectrader Ring in line. Upon arrival on Captivity, Rolo organized the other criminals on the moon into a vicious band of cutthroats, who grew to dominate the other groups of prisoners, save a group of [[Politics/Legends|political]] prisoners led by former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dedelin]].<ref name="FTF" />

When a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents purposely got themselves interred on Captivity disguised as the [[Rajah]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] and his [[Royal Court]] to rescue the political prisoners, Rolo found them first. After an altercation with his [[Rolo's Ruffians|group]], the Alliance team encountered Dedelin and his group, and rescued them.<ref name="FTF" />

==Personality and traits==
Rolo's descent into criminality was caused by two factors; necessity, and his own hatred towards society in general. He was a shrewd, bitter man with a vicious streak. While on Captivity, Rolo's hair was matted and scraggly, but his beard was perfectly trimmed.<ref name="FTF" />
